title: The far anchors were repr-t height artifacts, not mpmath corruption: every old census probe ran mpmath at mpf(repr(f64 t)); the old values reproduce EXACTLY at the repr heights under independent channels (5e7G mpmath 16 digits, 1e8G/3e8G C to 12-13); s34o re-issues all eight far rows on exact-t C zeta with ALL M unchanged and exactly quantized; s33b breaks the B7 degeneracy - the far M drift is a pure quadratic in t over three decades; the C channel's double-t quantization bug is found and fixed; MFar.lean pins the far-quadratic identity in Lean (GATED)
body: DATA + FORMAL MILESTONE (no RH claim).  MECHANISM FOUND:  s30_far_extreme.py and s31z2_5e8G_zeta.py both evaluated zeta at mp.mpf(repr(t)) with t the row's f64 height - the shortest round-trip decimal, whose EXACT value (mpf is decimal-exact) is OFFSET from the exact f64 integer: 2e6G -2, 5e6G +12, 1e7G +24, 2e7G +48, 5e7G +120, 1e8G +240, 3e8G -256, 5e8G +200, 1e9G +400, 1e10G -26848, 3e10G -46080.  Zero density is ~6 per unit t at these heights, so |Z| changes O(1) per unit of offset - the old 'corrupted' anchors were simply the true zeta values at the repr heights.  REPRODUCTION (independent channels):  5e7G - fresh mpmath at t+120 returns 0.5676737452478491, matching the old recorded anchor to ALL 16 printed digits (tmp/s34p_5e7G_shift.log); 1e8G - the C/quad channel at t+240 returns 4.492961809935 vs old anchor 4.4929618099354 (tmp/s34u_sens.log); 3e8G - C at t-256 returns -1.572802180239 vs old anchor -1.5728021802385705 (tmp/s34v_3e8G.log).  CONSEQUENCE:  mpmath 1.4.1 has not been shown wrong at any height in this audit; the s31z2 5e8G anchor (1.7289704098) was ALSO at the repr height (source uses mpf(repr(t))) - the two 5e8G 'classes' differ in HEIGHT, not state; confirmation runs queued (fresh mpmath at repr 5e8G = T4; forced-low entry width at exact 5e8G = T3; s34l T1 LANDED CLEAN - entry prec 173, captured S1 width 235, logabsz 2.937019955061246 = the C value to all digits; T2, the second fresh process, is RUNNING for the determinism call).  RE-ISSUE (s34o):  all EIGHT far rows (5 sub-wall + 3 extreme) recomputed with M = eps + lz - lm - la - re - I_far (canonical left-to-right f64) on the exact-t C logzeta channels:  ALL M VALUES UNCHANGED (M_shift = 0 for every row) and ALL exactly integer-quantized (resid 0.0) - the M channel is demonstrably uncoupled from O(1-5) lz noise at these scales.  Re-anchored channels (of record, exact t, C/quad):  2e6G 0.865468081636, 5e6G -3.111670188752, 1e7G 0.122468610055, 2e7G 1.242954054874, 5e7G -1.395123890841, 1e8G 1.455437142349, 3e8G 3.284789950625, 5e8G 2.937019955061, 1e9G -1.211098446310, 1e10G 0.455887846369, 3e10G 2.012486593295.  C-CHANNEL TOOLING FIX:  the zchain struct held t as a C DOUBLE and the ZETAC_TEST_T hook parsed with STRTOD - BOTH silently quantize far heights to the f64 grid (the earlier 'height-flatness' test was their artifact: t+240 collapsed onto t); the hook is now strtoflt128 + an f128 override (g_test_t); the table rows are UNAFFECTED (each literal rounds to the exact f64 integer - verified digit by digit - so every recorded C value was already at the exact row height).  After the fix C demonstrably distinguishes neighboring heights (1e8G exact vs +240: 1.455437142349 vs 4.492961809935).  B7 BREAK (s33b, 39 rows, far set through 3e10G, tmp/s33b_stdout.txt):  the far DRIFT D = M - (A ln t + B) with A = -25271000, B = +523877900 (the near-face fit) is a PURE QUADRATIC in t over three decades:  D(1e9G) = -9774967307.0, D(1e10G) = -977529165494.1 (ratio 100.00332), D(3e10G) = -8797765678430.4 (ratio 9.0000033);  c = |D|/t^2 = 1.0860e-29 stable to 3 digits;  in g = t/G units M ~ -9.776e-9 g^2 dominates.  The s33 position-amplitude degeneracy is BROKEN on the measured domain:  the far M law is not the near log law - the residual shape is exactly identified, no free shape parameter.  FORMAL:  formal/RhAttack/MFar.lean GATED (build green) - the four past-the-wall/far M values and the three D values are pinned as Real defs (s33b record) and pinGates machine-checks the quadratic identity FROM THE PINS with norm_num (height steps within 1e-4 with the f64 grid rounding inside the windows - t10 = 10 t9 - 49152, t30 = 3 t10 + 65536 - adjacent |D| ratio windows [100.00,100.01] and [9.00,9.01], c within 0.1% across decades, |M30| <= 1.01 c t30^2).  96 cards / 715 body lines; _MAP updated.  DOCS:  docs/MPMATH-RSSUM-ISSUE.md rewritten v2 (the repr-t audit record; NOT filed upstream); PATHWAY section 2 rewritten (the C/quad+rssum block becomes the far-anchor adjudication; the s33 s-degeneracy-survives reading is superseded by s33b).  PENDING (queued, memory-staggered):  T2 determinism call, T3 forced-low entry width at exact 5e8G, T4 fresh mpmath at repr 5e8G, s34k boundary probe, s34w low-row shift confirmations (2e6G/5e6G/1e7G/2e7G repr tests).  No RH claim.
